# --- RECOMP SETTINGS and Screen Settings pages, the game's own menu (src/pc_menu.c)

en: Smooths the edges of the 3D; 2x to 8x samples a pixel.
zh: 多重采样抗锯齿（MSAA），平滑3D画面边缘

en: The shape of the picture and the window sizes offered.
zh: 画面比例，以及可选的窗口大小

en: The size of the window when not full screen.
Graphics and display settings of the PC version.
Sets the resolution the game is drawn at.
zh: 设置游戏画面的渲染分辨率

en: Keeps textures sharp at an angle; Off is the console's filtering.
zh: 各向异性过滤：远处与侧面的纹理更清晰，关为原版

en: Sets the resolution of the character shadows.
zh: 设置角色阴影的分辨率

en: A window, the whole screen, or a window without a frame.
zh: 窗口、全屏或无边框窗口

en: No tearing. Mailbox: least delay. FIFO: steadiest. Adaptive: a late frame goes at once.
zh: 画面与刷新同步。Mailbox：延迟最低，FIFO：最稳定，自适应：迟到的帧立即显示

en: Shows the frame rate in a corner of the screen.
Starts at the title screen, from the next start.
zh: 下次启动起直接进入标题画面

en: Shows the settings screen before the game, from the next start.
zh: 下次启动起，在游戏前显示设置画面

en: Render resolution, texture filtering, anti-aliasing, shadows and the glow.
zh: 渲染分辨率、纹理过滤、抗锯齿、阴影与泛光

en: Aspect ratio, window size, display mode, V-Sync, the FPS counter, the HUD and the intros.
zh: 画面比例、窗口大小、显示模式、垂直同步、帧率、界面显示与片头。

en: The health and Ninpo bar, weapons and the rest drawn over play. Off: a clear screen.
zh: 游戏中叠加在画面上的体力与忍法条、武器等。关：画面干净

en: Speakers. Auto: 5.1 when the output device has 5.1 or 7.1 channels, else stereo. From the next start.
zh: 自动：输出设备有5.1或7.1声道时用5.1，否则用立体声。下次启动起生效

en: Sounds placed left and right. Console: the sound chip's filters. Panning: their placement only, clearer.
zh: 把声音分到左右。主机原版：经过音效芯片的滤波。声像：只保留定位，声音更清晰

en: Shows or hides the HUD (Display > HUD). Not bound unless chosen.
zh: 显示或隐藏界面（显示 → 界面显示）。默认不绑定

en: Returns to the Recomp Settings screen.
Ryu's health stays full. For this session only.
zh: 龙的体力始终全满。仅本次有效

en: Ninpo is always ready. For this session only.
zh: 忍法随时可用。仅本次有效

en: As much essence as can be held. For this session only.
zh: 精魂保持在持有上限。仅本次有效

en: Help for a hard spot: health, ninpo, essence, items and projectiles. Not saved.
zh: 难关助力：体力、忍法、精魂、道具与飞行道具。不会保存

en: Every difficulty at New Game, Ninja Dog to Master Ninja.
zh: 新游戏可选全部难度，从忍犬到超忍

en: All 50 Golden Scarabs: Muramasa gives every reward. For this session only.
zh: 全部50只圣甲虫，可领村正全部宝物。仅本次有效

en: Every costume at the Costume Selection, and three it never offers.
zh: 服装选择提供全部服装，另加三套隐藏服装

en: Costumes in the game's files it never offers. From the next area.
zh: 游戏文件中未开放的服装。从下一区域起生效

en: The keys, mouse buttons and controller buttons used in play.
zh: 游戏中使用的各种操作按键

en: A softer, fainter glow on bright lights. Off: the console's.
zh: 亮光的泛光更柔和、更淡。关：主机原版

en: Eases off detail when busy, as on the Xbox; Ryu's shadow may flicker.
zh: 负载高时降低画质（与Xbox相同），龙的影子可能闪烁

en: Every weapon, at its highest level. Turned off, they are taken back.
zh: 全部武器，均为最高等级。关闭后收回

en: Difficulties, costumes and the main menu's extras (saved); weapons, armlets and scrolls (this session).
zh: 难度、服装与主菜单的附加项目（会保存）。武器、腕轮与秘传书（仅本次有效）

en: Start at the title, in a cutscene's opening wait and after equipping in the pause menu works at once.
zh: 标题画面、过场开头的等待和暂停菜单装备后，按开始键立即生效

en: Every armlet and band. Turned off, they are taken back.
zh: 全部腕轮与结。关闭后收回

en: The Izuna Drop, Counter Attack and Guillotine Throw scrolls. Turned off, they are taken back.
zh: 饭纲落、化劲之法、斩首投的秘传书。关闭后收回

en: Any hit that hurts an enemy or a boss kills it. For this session only.
zh: 任何对敌人或头目造成伤害的一击都会直接击杀。仅本次有效

en: MISSIONS in the main menu without earning it.
zh: 主菜单的任务模式无需达成条件直接开放

en: ARCADE NINJA GAIDEN in the main menu without earning it.
zh: 主菜单的街机版忍者龙剑传无需达成条件直接开放

en: MOVIE THEATER in the main menu without earning it.
zh: 主菜单的影像鉴赏无需达成条件直接开放

en: A d-pad menu of weapons, Ninpo and items (Up and Down open it), at this size.
zh: 用十字键选择武器、忍法与道具的菜单（按上或下打开），以此大小显示

en: The game pauses while the quick menu is open (once Ryu's action ends).
zh: 打开快速菜单时游戏暂停（龙的动作结束后）

en: Healing items, the Talisman of Rebirth and the jewels (Demon Seal, Life of the Gods, Spirit of the Devils...)\nare not used up. For this session only.
zh: 恢复道具、还魂护符与各种珠（魄封珠、神命珠、鬼神珠等）不会消耗。\n仅本次有效

en: Healing items, the Talisman of Rebirth and the Jewel of the Demon Seal are not used up.
zh: 恢复道具、还魂护符与魄封珠不会消耗。

en: Shuriken, smoke bombs, arrows and spears are not used up. For this session only.
zh: 手里剑、烟玉、箭与水中枪的鱼叉不会消耗。仅本次有效

en: Draws the game at a multiple of the console's resolution.
zh: 以主机分辨率的整数倍渲染游戏画面

en: Keeps textures sharp at an angle. Off: the console's filtering.
zh: 各向异性过滤：远处与侧面的纹理更清晰。关：主机原版

en: The detail of the characters' shadows; 1x is the console's.
zh: 角色阴影的精度，1x 为主机原版

en: Frames per second, in the corner of the screen.
zh: 在画面一角显示每秒帧数

en: Starts at the title screen. From the next start.
zh: 直接从标题画面开始。下次启动起生效

en: The settings screen before the game. From the next start.
zh: 在游戏前显示设置画面。下次启动起生效

en: Smooths the edges of the 3D: 2x to 8x samples a pixel.
zh: 多重采样抗锯齿（MSAA），平滑3D画面边缘

en: All 50: Muramasa gives every reward. For this session only.
zh: 全部50只：可领村正全部宝物。仅本次有效

en: Costumes in the game it never offers. From the next area.
zh: 游戏中未开放的服装。从下一区域起生效

en: How fast the right stick and the mouse turn the camera (play only).
zh: 右摇杆与鼠标转动镜头的速度（仅限游戏中）

en: Press the controller's button (wait to cancel).
zh: 请按下控制器按键（稍等即取消）

en: Press a key or mouse button (Esc cancels).
zh: 请按下键盘或鼠标按键（Esc 取消）
所有操作恢复为默认按键

en: A: change   X / Delete: clear   (play only; the menus keep theirs)
zh: A：更改　X / Delete：清除（仅限游戏操作，菜单按键不变）

en: Back to the main menu. Unsaved progress is lost.
zh: 返回主菜单。未保存的进度将会丢失

en: Closes the game. Unsaved progress is lost.
zh: 关闭游戏。未保存的进度将会丢失

zh: 跳跃；靠近墙壁时可沿墙奔跑

en: Casts the ninpo (Special Attack and Projectile together).
zh: 施展忍法（强攻击与飞行道具同按）

en: Runs at the nearest enemy (Attack and Jump together).
zh: 冲向最近的敌人（攻击与跳跃同按）

Looks through Ryu's eyes (the left stick's button).
zh: 以龙的视角观看（按下左摇杆）

zh: 转动镜头（右摇杆，鼠标亦可）

zh: 打开武器栏；菜单打开时选择上一类

en: Opens Consumables; while open, selects the next category.
zh: 打开道具栏；菜单打开时选择下一类

zh: 打开上一页的武器；菜单打开时选择上一项

zh: 打开下一页的武器；菜单打开时选择下一项

zh: 装备所选的武器或忍法，或使用所选的道具

ctx: # --- the settings over the game, F1 (src/ingame_menu.c; its rows' names from src/launcher.c)

en: Up/Down or mouse: choose    Left/Right or click: change    A / Enter: select    B / Esc / F1: resume
zh: 上/下或鼠标：选择　　左/右或点击：更改　　A / Enter：确定　　B / Esc / F1：继续游戏

en: Changes apply when you resume. Skip intros and the startup screen take effect next start.
zh: 继续游戏时应用更改。跳过片头与启动画面在下次启动时生效。

en: The resolution the game is drawn at: the console's 720x480 times this.
zh: 以主机 720x480 的倍数渲染。

en: Optional changes to how the game plays, each off unless chosen: the Quick Menu.
zh: 可选的玩法改动，未选择时均为关闭：快速菜单等

en: Resolution, texture filtering, anti-aliasing, shadows, the glow, and two options for slower PCs.
zh: 分辨率、纹理过滤、抗锯齿、阴影、泛光，以及两项适合低性能PC的选项

en: Help for a hard spot: health, ninpo, essence, items and projectiles. Not saved. And the unlocks.
zh: 难关助力：体力、忍法、精魂、道具与飞行道具（不保存），以及解锁

ctx: # --- 0.9.40-0.9.44 (Multithreaded Renderer, Clear, All Weapons, Essence-Only Charging, Skip Any Cutscene)

en: The buttons the prompts show. Auto: whichever controller or keyboard is in use.
zh: 提示显示的按键。自动：跟随正在使用的手柄或键盘

en: Drawing on a thread of its own, for slower CPUs. May have bugs. Needs restart.
zh: 在独立线程中绘制画面，适合性能低的CPU。可能有问题，重启游戏后生效

en: Sounds placed left and right. Clear: by level only. Console: as the Xbox on speakers, duller.
zh: 把声音分到左右。清晰：只按音量定位。主机原版：与Xbox接音箱时相同，声音不够清晰

en: Speakers. Auto: 5.1 when the output device has 5.1 or 7.1 channels, else stereo. Needs a restart of the game.
zh: 自动：输出设备有5.1或7.1声道时用5.1，否则用立体声。重启游戏后生效

en: Holding attack no longer charges an Ultimate Technique: only absorbing essence does.
zh: 按住攻击不再蓄力绝技，只有吸收精魂才能蓄力

en: Start skips any movie or in-game cutscene, watched before or not. Off: as on the Xbox.
zh: 按开始键可跳过任何影片与过场，不论是否看过。关：与Xbox相同

en: Cross: change   Square / Delete: clear   (play only; the menus keep theirs)
zh: ×：更改　□ / Delete：清除（仅限游戏操作，菜单按键不变）
